summary: A quieter Sunday with a cooling mood: big posts said the Pokémon card bubble is topping, and an X news story said 30th Celebration cards lost about half their value. Collector pain was loud and real: scalpers cutting kids in line, empty shelves, and PSA grading that costs a lot and takes months. On the crypto side, Collector Crypt got both praise (stock tripled, One Piece now its biggest category) and a viral complaint about its web app and no mobile app. Solflare Packs mentions were steady and positive, led by @witty_cruz and @AiFlippa ripping the Fire Poke pack, with no negative posts found.

sources_note: X search via the x connector, posts from 2026-11-01 09:00 UTC to 2026-11-02 09:00 UTC, 7 post searches and 1 X news search. Engagement numbers are copied from the X API at scan time. The DefiLlama volume figures and Collector Crypt revenue claims are unverified third-party posts; the 30th Celebration price drop item is an X news summary (Grok-written). Payments talk was thin: card, Apple Pay and Google Pay searches mostly returned unrelated deals, memecoin shills and trading posts, which were skipped. Restock bots (packpingnet, PokemonRestockd), resale listings, token shills ($CARDS CA posts, $SLABS, $FILLED, $RIPS), phygital NFT spam (SurRNFTs), and wallet-address replies in giveaway threads were skipped. Creators already in collector-base.csv or earlier daily files (e.g. @TiltRips, @makopnl, @AiFlippa) were excluded from new_creators. The robman1286 post includes a rival's promo code; we cite it only for the format.
